chapter: Childhood in Tyler, Beaumont and Houston
title: Moving to Beaumont
summary: His mother and stepfather moved to Beaumont, Texas, when he was about seven or eight.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That's a funny one, isn't it? Oh, dear. Well, listen, were there any kids at school also crazy about music?
Not at this school. When I left there, my mother and my stepdaddy went to Beaumont, Texas.
That's in the southern part of Texas.
Oh, so it was quite a move.
And, let's see, it's close to Houston, too.
But it was closer to Louisiana.
So when we got to Beaumont, I started
Well, how old were you then?
Oh, I was about -- I'd say seven or eight.
So you really lived in Tyler just til you were that old.
